title: Polish Potato Gratin
description: A classic French-inspired dish featuring crispy, golden potatoes baked to perfection.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine sliced potatoes and enough cold water to cover.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
In a large skillet, cook crumbled bacon over medium heat until crispy.
Remove bacon from skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside.
Add butter to skillet and sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Add grated cheese to skillet and stir until melted.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange a layer of potatoes.
Top with a layer of bacon, then a layer of cheese mixture.
Repeat layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
Sprinkle chopped parsley on top and serve hot.
